title: Dedication
text: To my wife, Sarah Urist Green, anagrammatically: Her great Russian Grin has treasure— A great risen rush. She is a rut-ranger; Anguish arrester; Sister; haranguer; Treasure-sharing, Heart-reassuring Signature Sharer Easing rare hurts. “But the pleasure isn’t owning the person. The pleasure is this. Having another contender in the room with you.” – Philip Roth, The Human Stain
